name: readiness-checklist
description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: the seven-dimension production readiness review (PRR), gated so a "yes" with no pointable artifact is a FAIL, not a pass with a caveat. readiness-fields-gate.sh refuses ops/state.md's readiness -> rollout transition on any unresolved or unpointed checklist item. Ships the readiness-checklist skill.

dependencies.note: Requires the core plugin from tokenmaxxxer-core installed alongside this plugin. Composes with rollout-plan, error-budget-policy, and postmortem to form the release-engineering phase-2 norm.
